summary: Build practical workplace DEI skills in five days. Assess workforce data, review HR processes, and plan measurable actions. Explore the course.
lede: Corporate diversity and inclusion training helps HR practitioners, DEI specialists, and people managers identify barriers to fair access and participation across employment practices. Using ISO 30415 and GRI 405/406 as references, learners practise building workforce representation baselines, reviewing structured interviews and pay patterns, and handling workforce data with privacy in mind. They also develop prioritized improvement actions and a concise progress-reporting outline.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level workplace DEI course is designed for people who shape employment practices, analyze workforce experience, or report on fair and inclusive work. It suits professionals who need practical ways to identify barriers and turn findings into manageable HR actions. This course is designed for: HR business partners reviewing recruitment and promotion practices against ISO 30415. DEI officers tracking representation gaps and coordinating workplace inclusion actions. Recruitment specialists checking job criteria and structured interview processes for bias. People analytics analysts preparing workforce representation and progression measures. Compensation analysts screening pay data for unexplained differences across employee groups. Learning and development managers reviewing equitable access to workplace learning. Employee relations specialists documenting discrimination concerns and response pathways. People managers addressing inclusive team practices and employee feedback. Sustainability reporting specialists compiling GRI 405 and GRI 406 workforce disclosures. Accessibility coordinators identifying workplace design and accommodation barriers.
prerequisites: No formal DEI qualification is specified as a prerequisite. Familiarity with workplace policies or HR processes can help you connect the exercises to your organization. Coding is not required. Bring a laptop with Excel access for spreadsheet-based exercises; advanced analytics and AI applications are introduced at a foundation level, not implemented.
